text: The authors say their debate protocol follows Kenton et al. (2024), among others: two instances of a large pretrained model are randomly assigned opposing answers and debate for a pre-determined number of turns, after which the transcript is kept. Their aim is to extract trustworthy information from the strong model via debate and use it to help train a better weak model.
title: Lang et al. follow Kenton et al.'s assigned-role debate to extract information for training a better weak model
